relic_drowned_coins.flavour: Minted in the lost kingdom before the mud came. They still know the way home.
relic_drowned_coins.clue: A watchman once kept something under the bell.
relic_drowned_coins.cap: Cap: parry window never above 300 ms.

relic_gatekeepers_grip.flavour: Taken from the hand that held Thornwood shut.
relic_gatekeepers_grip.clue: The hand that held the wood shut left something behind.
relic_gatekeepers_grip.cap: Cap: spam-parry window never above 8 ticks.

relic_hopeglass.flavour: Filled with the green elixir the old folk called hope. Time drinks it slowly.
relic_hopeglass.clue: Something green slept in the beast under the quarry.
relic_hopeglass.effect: On a parry, the world runs at half speed for 0.5 s. 5 s cooldown.

relic_sprotos_stride.flavour: Wraps of the beast-hero Sproto, who was never where the blow fell.
relic_sprotos_stride.clue: The giant prints remember a lighter step.
relic_sprotos_stride.effect: Roll i-frames end 17 → 20; a perfect dodge ends 9 → 12.
relic_sprotos_stride.cap: Cap: i-frames never end after tick 21; a perfect dodge never after 12.
relic_sprotos_stride.bonus: 3 perfect dodges against the Hollow Giant in one fight

relic_tinubus_broken_seal.flavour: Pried from the tyrant's hoard. It holds the moment open, and never again for him.
relic_tinubus_broken_seal.clue: The mill wheel once held a tyrant's mark.
relic_tinubus_broken_seal.effect: Attack input buffer 10 → 14 ticks; chain grace 8 → 12.
relic_tinubus_broken_seal.cap: Cap: +4 ticks at most on each.

relic_oracles_eye.flavour: A chip of the Speaking Stone. It shows the blow before the blow.
relic_oracles_eye.clue: The ridge glass still looks a moment ahead.
relic_oracles_eye.effect: Parryable wind-ups close a gold ring on the parry frame.

relic_deepbreath_bellows.flavour: The deep seam breathes for those who listen.
relic_deepbreath_bellows.clue: The deep earth breathes for those who listen.
relic_deepbreath_bellows.cap: Cap: block stamina never cut by more than 35%.

relic_elder_iron_rivet.flavour: Iron from the lost kingdom. Strike it, and it answers.
relic_elder_iron_rivet.clue: Struck iron from the old camps answers back.
relic_elder_iron_rivet.effect: 10% chance a blocked melee blow fires a free Guard Counter. 3 s cooldown.
relic_elder_iron_rivet.bonus: Fell 2 Gunners with their own reflected charged shot

relic_surgebriar.flavour: Grown where the wild surge runs closest to the ground. Blows lose their nerve in it.
relic_surgebriar.clue: The weaver's hedge keeps a living cuff.
relic_surgebriar.effect: 8% chance an unguarded hit is reduced to a block's chip. 4 s cooldown.
relic_surgebriar.cap: Cap: the chance never passes 10%. Never on unblockables.

relic_drakeplume.flavour: A drake's feather. The ground comes up gently to meet it.
relic_drakeplume.clue: What fell out of the sky still softens a landing.
relic_drakeplume.effect: Sprint stamina −30% (12 → 8.4 per second); plunge landings recover twice as fast.
relic_drakeplume.cap: Cap: sprint never costs less than 7 per second.

totem_elders_hearth.clue: The first fire you rest beside keeps a seat.
totem_elders_hearth.effect: Heals 1% of max health per second for 20 s, within 6 m.

totem_field_warden.flavour: The Grunts can't look away from it. Nobody knows why.
totem_field_warden.clue: Something in the orchard holds the small ones' gaze.
totem_field_warden.effect: Draws normal enemies within 10 m for 4 s. Elites ignore it.

totem_seekers_lantern.flavour: It shows what the valley hid in plain sight.
totem_seekers_lantern.clue: The valley hid a light for what sits in plain sight.
totem_seekers_lantern.effect: Chests and hidden pickups within 40 m shimmer for 30 s.

totem_turnstone.flavour: Plant it, and it turns one shot around.
totem_turnstone.clue: A stone in the salvage yard turns a shot around.
totem_turnstone.effect: Reflects one projectile every 4 s inside 5 m, for 20 s.
totem_turnstone.cap: Does not stack with Mirror Ward. In co-op, every 6 s.

totem_elders_seed.flavour: A piece of the Elder's garden, for the road.
totem_elders_seed.clue: The garden stones remember a seed for the road.
totem_elders_seed.effect: Refills one Sprout Tonic charge, then a heal circle for 10 s. Once per shrine rest.

totem_earthspeaker_stake.flavour: Drive it in, and the ground speaks a little early.
totem_earthspeaker_stake.clue: The quarry crew left a stake that hears the ground.
totem_earthspeaker_stake.effect: Ground attacks within 12 m show their mark 10 ticks early; enemies inside move 15% slower.
totem_earthspeaker_stake.cap: Slow never passes 15%. In co-op, the mark only.

totem_ember_quench_pail.clue: Smoke on the hills left a pail that puts fire out.
totem_ember_quench_pail.effect: Clears Burn within 6 m and grants Burn immunity for 3 s.

totem_skylure_post.flavour: Flyers come down to look. That's enough.
totem_skylure_post.clue: An ugly little post still brings flyers down to look.
totem_skylure_post.effect: A flying enemy within 30 m glides low for 2 s, once per placement. Bosses: once per phase.
